# Studio 87

> Studio 87 makes free, open source music production software: synth and effect plugins (VST3 and standalone), DJ tools, hardware synth controller plugins and Korg logue units. Linux first, with Windows and macOS builds for many. Built with JUCE and C++. Everything is free to use; to change or build on it, fork it on GitHub. Donations are welcome on Ko-fi.

Website: https://speakingcolors.github.io/
Source code and releases: https://github.com/SpeakingColors
Support: https://ko-fi.com/studio87
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sonatural_
About supporting the project: https://speakingcolors.github.io/support/
Privacy: https://speakingcolors.github.io/privacy/

## Synths

Free open source synth plugins for bass, leads, supersaws and wavetables.

- [SupurrSaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/supurrrsaw-vst/): A big supersaw, hoover and acid synth for trance, hard dance and house.
- [PurrOne](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrone/): A thick, smooth mono synth for fat basslines and singing leads. (test build)
- [JPurrr-8000](https://speakingcolors.github.io/jpurrr-8000/): A trance supersaw synth in the spirit of the Roland JP-8000. (test build)
- [Whiskerwave](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskerwave-vst/): A wavetable synth with morphing waves and a tool to sample your own gear. (test build)
- [Kick Kitten](https://speakingcolors.github.io/kickkitten/): Design your own trance kicks, from the thump to the punch. (test build)
- [Pawphet-800](https://speakingcolors.github.io/pawphet-800/): A cat-themed polyphonic analog-style synth in the spirit of the Pro-800 and Prophet-600.

## Compressors, limiters and EQ

Compressors, limiters, transient shaping and EQ in classic and new styles.

- [Apurrr2500](https://speakingcolors.github.io/apurrr2500/): A stereo bus compressor for gluing a mix together. (test build)
- [FetlinePounce](https://speakingcolors.github.io/fetlinepounce/): Fast, punchy FET-style compression for drums, vocals, bass and buses. (test build)
- [LapCat2A](https://speakingcolors.github.io/lapcat2a/): Smooth optical-style leveling for vocals, bass and anything that should sit evenly. (test build)
- [Furchild](https://speakingcolors.github.io/furchild/): A warm stereo variable-mu tube compressor in the Fairchild style. (test build)
- [Purrrstressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrrstressor/): A flexible compressor with a famous Nuke mode, inspired by the Distressor. (test build)
- [PunchPaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/punchpaw/): Make kicks and drums hit harder with a limiter built for punch. (test build)
- [Clawpressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/clawpressor-vst/): A four-band compressor and limiter with rhythmic gain patterns, tuned for house and hardstyle. (test build)
- [MultiPaw Compressor](https://speakingcolors.github.io/multipawcompressor/): Multiband compression and multiband sidechain in one plugin. (test build)
- [Purrr Voice Channel](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrrvoicechannel/): A tube channel strip for voices: preamp, compressor, de-esser, gate and EQ in one. (test build)
- [ClawShaper](https://speakingcolors.github.io/clawshaper/): Shape the punch and the tail of your drums, band by band. (test build)
- [Pawltec](https://speakingcolors.github.io/pawltec/): A tube program EQ with big, smooth lows and highs, in the Pultec style. (test build)
- [CatRack](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catrack/): A channel strip built from Studio 87's own effects: stack up to 12 in one window. (test build)
- [Softer Paws](https://speakingcolors.github.io/softerpaws/): A dynamic resonance suppressor that softens harsh, ringing frequencies.
- [Nine Lives](https://speakingcolors.github.io/ninelives/): Mastering and audio repair in one plugin: an assistant matches your track to a target.

## Saturation, distortion and tone

Warmth, grit, bass weight and loudness.

- [Cat Crusher](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catcrusher-vst/): Drive, crush and filter: tube, fold and hard-clip distortion in one plugin. (test build)
- [Fat Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/fatcat/): Thick saturation that keeps the dynamics of your sound. (test build)
- [Meowbass](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowbass/): Make small speakers sound like they have deep bass. (test build)
- [Meowximizer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowximizer/): A three-band enhancer for weight, presence and air. (test build)

## Space, rhythm and special effects

Reverb, ducking, volume shaping, phase fixing and freeze effects.

- [Purrrverb](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrrverb/): Shimmering reverbs and delays that glow. (test build)
- [Cat Spacer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catspacer/): Carve space for a lead or vocal by ducking only the frequencies that clash. (test build)
- [Scaredy Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scaredy-cat/): Draw volume curves for kick pumps, trance gates and chops. (test build)
- [phasepaw](https://speakingcolors.github.io/phasepaw/): See whether your kick and bass fight each other, and fix it.
- [Hairball](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hairball/): Freeze a sound, shred it into grains and turn it into something new. (test build)
- [Tail Chaser](https://speakingcolors.github.io/tailchaser/): Fades out the tails of reverbs, delays and room noise so your mix stays tight.
- [Meow Flipper](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowflipper/): Builds a reverse reverb for you: a swell that lands exactly on your sound.

## DJ and creative tools

Scratch, DJ decks, sample tools and generators.

- [Scratch Cat FX](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scratchcatfx-vst/): Scratch, brake and backspin the sound from your DAW. (test build)
- [Scratch Cat Duo](https://speakingcolors.github.io/scratchcatduo-vst/): Two DJ decks and a mixer in one plugin. (test build)
- [Stretch Cat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/stretch-cat-vst/): Change the speed without the pitch, or the pitch without the speed. (test build)
- [Copycat](https://speakingcolors.github.io/copycat-vst/): Hear a sound you love and find out how to rebuild it. (test build)
- [AI Purrformer](https://speakingcolors.github.io/ai-purrformer/): Sing badly, get a better voice back, on time and in key.

## Studio tools and apps

Editors, analysers, sample manager, mixer and the Gear Updater launcher.

- [Meowcorder](https://speakingcolors.github.io/meowcorder/): Record, cut and process sound quickly in the middle of a project. (test build)
- [Purrfect Cut](https://speakingcolors.github.io/purrfect-cut/): An audio editor and a vocal pitch tool in one install. (test build)
- [CATalog](https://speakingcolors.github.io/catalog/): Find the right sample fast: scan, search, tag, rate and preview. (test build)
- [Whisker Scope](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskerscope/): See your sound: scope, spectrum and frequency analyser. (test build)
- [WhiskerMix](https://speakingcolors.github.io/whiskermix/): A TotalMix-style mixer and studio hub for Linux. (test build)
- [Gear Updater](https://speakingcolors.github.io/gearupdater/): One app to browse, download and update all Studio 87 software. (test build)

## TV apps

A calmer home screen for your TV.

- [Stardrift TV Launcher](https://speakingcolors.github.io/stardrifttvlauncher/): A calm, ad-free home screen for Google TV: a slowly drifting night sky, your apps, your news, your shows.

## Hardware controller plugins

Control your hardware synths from your DAW on Linux.

- [Novation Peak controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/linux-peak-controller/): Edit and automate your Novation Peak from your DAW. (test build)
- [Novation UltraNova controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/linux-ultranova-controller/): Edit your Novation UltraNova or MiniNova from your DAW on Linux.
- [Korg minilogue xd controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/minilogue-xd-controller/): Edit and automate your Korg minilogue xd from your DAW. (test build)
- [Korg drumlogue controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/drumlogue-linux-controller/): Edit and automate your Korg drumlogue from your DAW on Linux. (test build)
- [Behringer JT-4000 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/jt4000-vst/): Edit and automate your Behringer JT-4000 Micro from your DAW. (test build)
- [Behringer PRO VS Mini controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/provsmini-vst/): A controller for the Behringer PRO VS Mini vector synth, in planning.
- [Yamaha MODX M controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/modxm-controller-vst/): Edit and automate your Yamaha MODX M from your DAW. (test build)
- [MX400 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/mx400-vst-linux/): Control your Lexicon MX400 effects unit from your DAW. (test build)
- [M-VAVE FM-1 controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/mwave-fm1-linux-vst/): A controller for the M-VAVE FM-1 on Linux, early work in progress.
- [Modal Cobalt8M controller](https://speakingcolors.github.io/cobalt8m-controller-vst/): Edit and automate your Modal Cobalt8M from your DAW. (test build)

## Recipe book

One book for synths that have no patch memory: write down your sounds as recipes.

- [Synth Cook Book](https://speakingcolors.github.io/synth-cook-book/): A patch recipe book for synths with no memory: Pro-1, CAT, TD-3-MO and TD-3. (test build)

## Korg minilogue xd and drumlogue units

Oscillator and effect units for the Korg minilogue xd and drumlogue.

- [MegaSaw XD](https://speakingcolors.github.io/megasaw-xd/): A bigger supersaw oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd.
- [hypersaw-xd](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hypersaw-xd/): Three layers of supersaw in one oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd. (test build)
- [sawwiden-xd](https://speakingcolors.github.io/sawwiden-xd/): A stereo widener for the Korg minilogue xd that keeps your bass in the middle. (test build)
- [hypersaw-drumlogue](https://speakingcolors.github.io/hypersaw-drumlogue/): A supersaw oscillator for the Korg drumlogue.
- [HyperSawX](https://speakingcolors.github.io/super-duper-stuff/): A 15-voice supersaw oscillator for the Korg minilogue xd.

## For developers

Shared building blocks and the Claude skills used to make this software.

- [cat-ui](https://speakingcolors.github.io/cat-ui/): The shared look of every Studio 87 plugin.
- [claude-skills](https://speakingcolors.github.io/claude-skills/): Free Claude skills for music makers, DJs and Linux users. (test build)
